agent_explanation: Body 1 (controller-driven hover vehicle) reaches its waypoint exactly at step 1227 (position equals waypoint 7.13516,9.59857 with ~0 speed). On the next update the controller must compute a direction to the target as (target-pos)/dist with dist=0, i.e. 0/0=NaN, producing a NaN force that integrates to NaN position/velocity (and NaN energy/work) at step 1228. Adding tiny sensor noise avoids the exact-zero distance and removes the failure.
